note: GA DNR state park, one of the oldest in the nation, on 105-acre McIntosh Lake and Sandy Creek near Flovilla. The campground is in the woods at the lake's northwest arm, reached by its own road from the north; cottages, boat ramp, mini golf and a seasonal museum. --Claude
